seen.body: Found by qew sync on qew's own ledger: mirror github-github.com-foundlings-qew-pr-1 names a pull request that does not exist on GitHub; the review read answers 404 and the whole pull reports failed on every sync. A 404 on the review reads means the PR is gone: skip it and remember it as read.
seen.title: PR review import: a tracked pull request that is gone (404) fails every pull
